observations: Black game console with two wireless controllers.
The console has a matte black finish and a distinctive split design.
The model 'PS4' is visible on the top edge in photo 0.
The controllers feature the standard PlayStation button layout (triangle, circle, cross, square).
The console is resting on a light-colored wooden surface.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'OLADAPO ROTIMI' are present on both images.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the PS4 logo on the top edge of the console.
photo 0 and photo 1 show two controllers.

risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controllers being used to navigate the system menu.
Video showing the console connected to a TV and displaying a game.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PS4 console with two controllers. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state until proof of operation is provided.
